text: He abused the new power the company gave him.
translation: 他滥用了公司给他的新权力。

text: Many workers abuse the sick leave they are given.
translation: 很多员工滥用病假。

text: They abuse the word meaning until it means nothing.
translation: 他们滥用词义直到它失去意义。

text: It is easy to abuse a weak old system.
translation: 滥用一个脆弱的旧制度很容易。

text: The old man abused his wife for many years.
translation: 那老人虐待妻子多年。

text: Do not abuse a child for small mistakes.
translation: 不要因为小错虐待孩子。

text: He abused his old body for forty hard years.
translation: 他辛苦劳作四十年糟践了自己的身体。
note: 过度使用（身体）= 虐待

text: No one should abuse an old sick animal.
translation: 不该有人虐待一只年老生病的动物。

text: He stopped one abuse of his habit years ago.
translation: 他多年前戒掉了一个恶习。

text: This abuse of the language makes it hard to learn.
translation: 这种对语言的滥用让它很难学。

text: Overwork is a common abuse among young workers.
translation: 过度劳累在年轻工人中是一种常见恶习。

text: It is a national abuse to believe such talk.
translation: 相信这种话是一种国民的恶习。

text: They kept an old abuse of long talks for years.
translation: 他们保留着长谈的老恶习很多年。

text: Do not abuse your parents with such words.
translation: 不要用这样的话辱骂父母。

text: He abused the workers who came to ask for pay.
translation: 他辱骂了来要工钱的工人。

text: They abused her in the cruelest words they knew.
translation: 他们用所知道的最狠的话辱骂她。

text: No one may abuse the flag of any country.
translation: 任何人都不得辱骂别国的旗帜。
note: 辱骂（庄严对象）= 辱骂

text: Drivers here abuse the new road every day.
translation: 这里的司机每天都滥用车行道。

text: He abused the dog for years before the police knew.
translation: 在警方知道之前，他虐待那只狗很多年。

text: She abused him again in front of the whole room.
clue: in front of the whole room
translation: 她又在满屋子人面前辱骂他。
